posture: 98 roles · 26 strong-act · 2 day-rate/interim briefs worth moving on today — afternoon refresh, every item re-opened in Chrome; 88 of 89 morning items re-confirmed live, 1 dropped, 10 new roles added
summary: The afternoon sweep added ten roles, and the two worth acting on both landed today: a Head of Enterprise Risk at Resimac, listed within the hour, and a Group Manager, Business Improvement & Assurance at City of Parramatta on a term contract to 2029 at $228k–$253k plus super — local government and an assurance mandate together, which is the closest match this radar has surfaced in weeks. One morning item dropped out: the Ethos BeathChapman day-rate Director, Risk, Compliance & Safety brief expired during the day, which is the usual pattern for recruiter-held contract work and the reason speed matters on the interim surface. The only fresh day-rate brief is Bluefin's three-month finance applications manager role at $900–$1,000 a day; if interim work is the priority, being registered and CV-current with Bluefin, Kaizen, JS Careers, KPP, Robert Half and Sharp & Carter still matters more than watching the boards. Browser-verified this run: Seek (query battery plus Board Appointments), EthicalJobs, Robert Half, Kaizen, Bluefin, and every carried-forward I Work for NSW listing individually. I Work for NSW's search index could not be swept this afternoon — the site returned gateway timeouts and its keyword filter stopped returning results — so new NSW government postings since this morning may be missing and a manual look there is worthwhile. AICD Directorship Opportunities remains member-gated and was not scanned beyond public teasers.

items.summary: Portfolio and credit risk management role at a non-bank lender specialising in real estate finance.
items.so_what: Credit and portfolio risk is adjacent to rather than inside your core enterprise-risk track, and the level sits below your tier. Useful sector intelligence on the non-bank lending market.

items.headline: Senior Advisor, Audit & Compliance — NSW Department of Customer Service, Sydney City
items.summary: Senior advisor role covering investigation, audit and legislative compliance work within a central NSW agency.
items.so_what: Below your level, but a useful read on where the department is investing in assurance capability. Situational awareness only.

items.headline: Assistant Manager, Audit, Risk & Integrity (integrity lead) — Commonwealth DPP, Sydney
items.summary: Federal prosecution agency is recruiting an EL1 assistant manager to lead its integrity work within the audit and risk team, with the role open in Sydney, Melbourne or Canberra.
items.so_what: The function is right but the EL1 grade sits below your level. Useful as a read on where Commonwealth agencies are investing in integrity and assurance capability.
items.source: Seek / Office of the Director of Public Prosecutions

items.headline: Assistant Manager, Governance & Secretariat — Commonwealth DPP, Sydney
items.summary: EL1 governance and secretariat role supporting committee decision-making and corporate governance processes across the agency, also open in Melbourne and Canberra.
items.so_what: Board-secretariat work that maps to your company-secretary interests, but pitched a grade or two below where you would come in.
items.source: Seek / Office of the Director of Public Prosecutions

items.headline: Senior Internal Auditor — international insurer via Profusion PAC, Sydney (hybrid, $170k–$180k)
items.summary: Established international insurance group is adding a senior internal auditor to a function focused on independent assurance across a heavily regulated environment.
items.so_what: Insurance and internal audit are both core to your background, but the role sits below manager level. Worth a call to the recruiter if you want a route into that audit function at a higher grade.

items.headline: Head of WHSEQ — JCDecaux, Sydney (hybrid)
items.summary: Out-of-home media group is hiring a head of work health, safety, environment and quality to lead its assurance and compliance agenda across Australian operations.
items.so_what: The 'Head of' grade and the quality/assurance half of the brief are in range, but the centre of gravity is WHS rather than enterprise risk or finance. Situational awareness only.

items.headline: Head of Financial Planning & Analysis — Australian Prudential Regulation Authority, Sydney (hybrid)
items.summary: Head-of-function role advising the CFO on financial planning strategy for the prudential regulator, accountable for budget development, performance tracking and advice to senior leaders.
items.so_what: Head-of level at a federal regulator, with a finance remit that trades on exactly the governance instincts you have. Still open — apply while the field is small.

items.headline: Senior Financial Controller — private advertiser, Sydney
items.summary: Senior financial controller appointment advertised directly by the employer without naming the business.
items.so_what: Financial controller is a named target title and this one is senior-qualified, but the anonymous posting makes it hard to judge sector fit. Worth an application to find out who is behind it.

items.headline: Financial Controller — via Robert Half, Sydney CBD
items.summary: Financial controller appointment placed through Robert Half's Sydney CBD finance and accounting desk.
items.so_what: A core target title with a recruiter you want to stay visible to for interim work. Confirm whether the brief is permanent or contract before investing time.

items.headline: FP&A Lead — Takeda Pharmaceuticals Australia, Sydney
items.summary: Financial planning and analysis leadership role in the Australian arm of a global pharmaceutical group, sitting in the strategy and planning function.
items.so_what: FP&A leadership at a large multinational is a solid finance credential, though the role is narrower than a full head-of-finance seat. Posted overnight.

items.headline: Director Investments — NSW Department of Climate Change, Energy, the Environment & Water, Sydney (hybrid)
items.summary: Director-level appointment in corporate finance and investment within the NSW environment and energy department, working on the state's environmental and energy investment portfolio.
items.so_what: Director level, energy and environment subject matter, and NSW public sector — three of your strongest threads in one role. The investment focus is a stretch from pure risk and finance, so read the capability framework carefully.

items.headline: Business Manager, Governance and Legal — Housing Australia, Sydney (hybrid)
items.summary: Business manager supporting the governance and legal function of the Australian Government's independent housing delivery agency.
items.so_what: Federal agency governance with a competitive package, though the role is classified under executive support rather than a true governance leadership seat — check the actual scope before applying.

items.headline: Business Services Manager / Senior Manager — mid-tier chartered firm via Lawson Elliott, Sydney CBD (hybrid, $150k–$180k package)
items.summary: Mid-tier accounting practice is hiring at manager or senior-manager level into business services and corporate advisory, with an ongoing client fee base attached.
items.so_what: Your CPA credentials and finance depth fit, and the senior-manager band is at your level — the judgement call is whether a practice-side advisory role is the direction you want.

items.headline: Director, Portfolio Delivery and Governance — via xceltium, Sydney (hybrid)
items.summary: Director-level role combining portfolio delivery leadership with governance over a technology investment portfolio, advertised with a highly attractive package.
items.so_what: Portfolio governance is a genuine use of both the engineering and assurance sides of your background, at director level. Recruiter-held and posted yesterday.

items.headline: Strategy Lead, Financial Services Transformation — Velocity Frequent Flyer (Virgin Australia), Sydney
items.summary: Strategy leadership role driving financial services transformation within Virgin Australia's loyalty business.
items.so_what: Transformation strategy in a financial services adjacency, with a recognisable brand. The role is analysis-led rather than governance-led, so weigh how well it uses your risk credentials.

items.headline: Senior Project Manager, Business Special Projects — City of Parramatta, Sydney (hybrid, $160k–$177k)
items.summary: Council is recruiting a senior project manager for a business special-projects portfolio on a full-time term contract, sitting alongside its business improvement and assurance group.
items.so_what: Local government affinity and a transformation brief make this a reasonable fit, though it is a delivery role rather than a governance one. Consider it alongside the Parramatta group-manager post above.

items.headline: Senior Manager, Data & Analytics — market-leading lender via Reo Group, Sydney (hybrid, $165k–$185k plus super and bonus)
items.summary: Financial services lender is hiring a senior manager to lead an established data and analytics team and drive commercially oriented decision-making.
items.so_what: Senior-manager grade in financial services with a technology-leadership brief plays to your software engineering background, though it is more analytics-led than risk-led.

items.headline: Interim Finance Manager (3-month contract, immediate start) — commercial law firm via Moir Group, Sydney ($700–$800 per day plus super)
items.summary: Three-month interim finance management engagement at an established Sydney commercial law firm with a long-standing client base, starting immediately.
items.so_what: A clearly priced day-rate brief with an immediate start — the exact interim shape you want and rare to see advertised publicly. Call Moir Group today; briefs at this rate are usually filled inside a week.

items.headline: Interim Finance Transformation Manager — global business via Derwent Search, Sydney (hybrid)
items.summary: Contract engagement supporting a global business through significant operational and finance transformation.
items.so_what: Derwent runs a dedicated interim solutions desk and also handles board and CEO search — worth the call for this brief and for the relationship. Interim assignments from this firm rarely stay advertised long.

items.headline: Interim Program Director — via Derwent Search, Sydney
items.summary: Interim program director engagement placed through Derwent's interim solutions practice.
items.so_what: Director-level interim work, though program delivery rather than risk or finance. Advertised for a fortnight now, so likely a hard brief — but a useful reason to open the conversation with Derwent's interim desk.

items.headline: Manager, Application Services (Finance) — major Sydney university via Bluefin Resources (3-month contract, $900–$1,000 per day plus super)
items.summary: Urgent three-month parental-leave cover leading a seven-person team that supports the university's finance applications and platforms, including its TechnologyOne financials stack.
items.so_what: A day-rate brief sitting exactly at the intersection of your finance and software engineering backgrounds, and Bluefin move fast on these. Capped at watch only because it is a plain manager grade — call them today if the rate suits.
